tool_schemas.name: search_crates
tool_schemas.description: Searches the indexed crate catalog for the given query string and returns a paged list of matching crates; pagination is controlled by page (starting at 1) and perPage. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty or if page/perPage are not positive numbers. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded and INTERNAL_ERROR on unexpected indexing failures.

tool_schemas.name: get_crate_documentation
tool_schemas.description: Returns the stored rustdoc documentation entrypoint and associated metadata for the requested crateName and optional version (defaults to the latest indexed version). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if crateName is empty or version is malformed, and NOT_FOUND if the crate does not exist or the requested version is not indexed/available. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded and INTERNAL_ERROR if the documentation artifact cannot be read.

tool_schemas.name: get_type_info
tool_schemas.description: Looks up and returns the resolved type page/info for a specific rustdoc path within a crate documentation set for the requested crateName and optional version (defaults to latest). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if crateName/path are empty or if path is not a valid rustdoc-relative page path, and NOT_FOUND if the crate/version is missing or the requested type page does not exist. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded and INTERNAL_ERROR on unexpected lookup failures.

tool_schemas.name: get_feature_flags
tool_schemas.description: Returns the feature flags declared by the requested crateName at the specified version (defaults to the latest indexed version). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if crateName is empty or version is malformed, and NOT_FOUND if the crate or version is not indexed/available. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded and INTERNAL_ERROR if feature metadata cannot be retrieved.

tool_schemas.name: get_crate_versions
tool_schemas.description: Lists all indexed published versions known for the given crateName and returns them as a single, unpaged collection ordered by our catalog’s version ordering. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if crateName is empty and NOT_FOUND if the crate is not present in the index. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded and INTERNAL_ERROR on unexpected catalog failures.

tool_schemas.name: get_source_code
tool_schemas.description: Returns the vendored source file contents (and any available metadata) for the given crateName, rustdoc/source path, and optional version (defaults to latest). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if crateName/path are empty or if path is not a valid file path, and NOT_FOUND if the crate/version is missing or the file does not exist in the stored sources. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded and INTERNAL_ERROR if the source artifact cannot be read.

tool_schemas.name: search_symbols
tool_schemas.description: Searches extracted symbol metadata within the requested crateName and optional version (defaults to latest) for the given query and returns matching symbols as an unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if crateName or query is empty or version is malformed, and NOT_FOUND if the crate/version is not indexed/available. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded and INTERNAL_ERROR on unexpected symbol-index failures.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns information about the calling identity, including its subject, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses with UNAUTHENTICATED when no valid credentials are presented and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

apiKey.description: API key used to authenticate the request

tool_schemas.name: get_crate
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single crate record by crateName and returns its metadata as stored in the catalog. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if crateName is empty, NOT_FOUND if the crate does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: upsert_crate
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new crate record or updates an existing one (by name) with the provided metadata and status. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs are malformed, CONFLICT if attempting to rename an existing crate, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

apiKey.description: API key used to authenticate the request

crateName.description: Name of the crate to create or update

documentation_url.description: Canonical documentation URL for the crate

latest_version.description: Latest known version string; may be null if unknown

tool_schemas.name: refresh_crate_versions
tool_schemas.description: Ingests or refreshes published version metadata for the given crateName from the upstream registry and upserts crate_versions (including features, yanked flags, checksums, and published_at). Returns the updated crate and the number of versions inserted/updated. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if crateName is empty, NOT_FOUND if the crate is unknown to the service, RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded, and INTERNAL_ERROR if upstream registry data cannot be retrieved.

apiKey.description: API key used to authenticate the request

crateName.description: Name of the crate to refresh

includeYanked.description: Whether to include yanked versions during refresh (defaults to true)

force.description: Whether to bypass caches and force a full refresh (defaults to false)

tool_schemas.name: start_crate_version_indexing
tool_schemas.description: Transitions the resolved crate version to status='indexing' and enqueues a build/fetch job to produce doc_pages, symbols, and source_files for that version. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the crate or version does not exist, CONFLICT if the version is disabled, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

apiKey.description: API key used to authenticate the request

version.description: Specific version (defaults to crates.latest_version; NOT_FOUND if latest_version is null)

priority.description: Queue priority for the indexing job (defaults to normal)

tool_schemas.name: update_crate_version_status
tool_schemas.description: Updates lifecycle fields for a crate version, including status transitions and error/indexed timestamps used by the indexing pipeline. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions, NOT_FOUND if the crate/version does not exist, CONFLICT when attempting to set status='indexed' without required artifacts (at least one present doc page and at least one active symbol unless the crate is empty), and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

apiKey.description: API key used to authenticate the request

version.description: Specific version (defaults to crates.latest_version; NOT_FOUND if latest_version is null)

status.description: New status for the crate version

last_error.description: Error message when marking a version as failed; null clears the last error

indexed_at.description: Timestamp to set when marking a version as indexed; required when status='indexed' and must be omitted/null otherwise

metadata.name: Rust Docs Server
